track: B — explicitly anchored LFS local finality

contracts.identity: Do not accept bootstrap peer with wrong transport-certificate node id
contracts.state_restore: The named anchor ancestry and pre/post-state must match byte-for-byte
contracts.checkpoint: The restart must retain the recovered state without silently re-entering LFS
contracts.local_finality: Do not infer local finality merely because operator named an anchor
contracts.archival_history: Sibling branches / full finalized prefix are not guaranteed by ordinary LFS

experiments.confounding_observation: equivocation logged after restart; causality not established

experiments.note: Monotonic time correction did not resolve anchored LFS finality in this scenario

experiments.failure: Initial explicitly anchored fringe reply was never observed at joiner within 140 seconds; no reactivation executed.
observations: Joiner sent FinalizedFringeRequest to authenticated bootstrap id at 172.18.0.2
Bootstrap logged including 5 block fringes and handling/sending its response
Bootstrap additionally logged connection-refused handshake warnings for joiner
Joiner log has no received finalized-fringe response; LFS timed out
experiments.caution: 'FinalizedFringe sent' is a sender-side log; it does not independently prove the receiving node received or authenticated the reply.

conclusions: Passive recovery passed once with exact state, anchor local finality, and durable checkpoint.
Absence of validator signing during recovery may remove a contributing race, but does not establish a causal fix.
The first attempted key-reactivation campaign failed during initial LFS before key activation; it cannot be treated as a reactivation verdict.
Current logs are consistent with lost/unavailable reply delivery or handshake/retry timing; exact cause remains UNRESOLVED.

next_falsifiable_test.condition: Repeat a disposable isolated initial passive anchor recovery with explicit per-request and per-response transport acknowledgement, receive confirmation, and time-stamped retry tracking.
hypotheses: Fringe reply transport fails or is dropped during reset connection establishment
The reply is accepted by transport but ignored/misrouted before NodeSyncing
The responder does not actually deliver a peer-acknowledged response despite 'sent' log
required_invariants: Do not weaken bootstrap identity binding
Do not mark a sync PASS before finality and checkpoint agree
Preserve the same data volume for post-passive key activation

release_blocker: Anchored-LFS local-finality and key-reactivation assurance incomplete; do not promote to release-ready.
